title: Add an explicit declined-payment outcome
requirement: Treat payment method declined as a recognized authorization failure rather than an unknown method. Introduce a distinct typed PaymentDeclined outcome through the authorization and checkout error path, and exhaustively map it to HTTP 402 with exact body payment declined. Card/bank authorization and unknown payment methods retain their behavior. Inventory and pricing validation still happen before authorization, so earlier invalid input errors retain priority. Preserve all unrelated behavior.
scope: One independent change to the supplied baseline; implement and verify without a human review gate.
acceptance: Behavior is checked through HTTP against the task and unchanged baseline contracts. Payment-boundary additionally has an explicit structural check. Add or update meaningful public tests.
limits: Do not change compiler, vendored guide, AGENTS.md, task.json or this task specification. Use the allowed tool protocol; analysis tools are optional only in the analysis condition.
